findings.highlight: I never really had any plans to practice kendo seriously, and I was really only taught how to fight opponents wielding a sword.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は本気で剣道をしようという気もなく、ただ相手が長物を持っていた場合はどうするか、なんていう対応をたたき込まれただけである。
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu taught Shirou only how to respond if an opponent carried a long implement or weapon.
findings.explanation: Responding to any opponent with a long weapon becomes fighting a swordsman.

findings.highlight: "Huh. If you prefer me armored, I can change. You are right...I was not thinking.
findings.evidenceJa: 「はあ。武装している方がいい、というのでしたら着替えますが。……そうですね、私がどうかしていました。
findings.governingReading: Saber infers that training unarmored was disrespectful and says she herself was thoughtless.
findings.explanation: Saber blaming her own discourtesy becomes agreeing with Shirou.

findings.highlight: Saber seems distracted as she catches the shinai and stares at me quietly.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは心ここにあらず、といった体で竹刀を受け取って、まじまじとこちらを見つめていた。
findings.governingReading: Distracted, Saber receives the shinai and studies Shirou closely.
findings.explanation: Saber staring intently becomes staring quietly.

findings.highlight: "That's a relief. It'd be too noisy to spar with wooden swords.
findings.evidenceJa: 「良かった。さすがに木刀で試合をするのは物騒すぎる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou is relieved because sparring with wooden swords would be too dangerous or alarming.
findings.explanation: Wooden-sword sparring being dangerous becomes noisy.

findings.highlight: "That will not be necessary. From what I've observed, your athletic abilities are above average. If we intended to further fortify your body, it would take more than a day or two."
findings.evidenceJa: 「その必要はないでしょう。私から見ても、シロウの運動能力は水準に達しています。これ以上肉体面を鍛えるのであれば、それは一日や二日で出来る事ではありません」
findings.governingReading: Saber judges Shirou's athletic capacity to have reached the required level; further bodily improvement would take longer than a day or two.
findings.explanation: Meeting the necessary athletic standard becomes being above average.

findings.highlight: "But it will not be enough for you to defend yourself.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ですが、それは武器になるほどの物ではありません。
findings.governingReading: Shirou's physique is not poor for a warrior, but it is not enough to become a meaningful weapon against a Servant; Saber will therefore give him combat experience.
findings.explanation: Insufficient ability to serve as a weapon becomes inability to defend himself.

findings.highlight: The floor is slippery with sweat. We are not trying to carry out mock battles in extreme situations, so there is no point in carrying on while we are exhausted and on unstable footing."
findings.evidenceJa: 床も汗で滑りやすくなっている。極限状態での模擬戦でもなし、疲労困憊して足場も不確か—などという状態では意味がありません」
findings.governingReading: The floor is slippery with sweat and Shirou is exhausted; this is not an extreme-condition simulation.
findings.explanation: Shirou's exhaustion becomes shared exhaustion with Saber.

findings.highlight: Your best way to fight should be to fully prepare yourself, then pursue the best course of action in a given situation."
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の戦いは、まず自身を万全にし、的確な状況を模索する事から始まるのです」
findings.governingReading: Shirou's battle begins by putting himself in full condition and seeking an appropriate situation; outside those conditions he cannot even make a fight of it.
findings.explanation: A prerequisite and starting point becomes merely the best method.

findings.evidenceJa: 肺にたまったモノを吐き出す。
findings.governingReading: The thing Shirou exhales should be mere air, but it feels hot enough to burn.
findings.explanation: Breath hot enough to burn becomes disembodied heat.

findings.highlight: I started getting enough time and awareness to intuit that the next attack would kill me. So I had just enough time to think to myself,
findings.governingReading: As he adapts, Shirou first has room to think Oh, I messed up, and then describes the sharpened intuition that he will be killed in the next instant.
findings.explanation: Shirou's thought is moved after its explanatory narration.

findings.highlight: Practice so I'm neither confused nor too calm in the face of the enemy.
findings.evidenceJa: 敵を目の前にしても混乱せず、かといって冷静すぎず。
findings.governingReading: The exercise teaches Shirou not only to avoid confusion or excess calm but to carry the heat of knowing death is always one step away.
findings.explanation: The life-or-death heat of combat becomes a bare proposition about mistakes.

findings.highlight: I'm so exhausted, I'm dripping sweat all over the floor. Saber isn't even breathing hard.
findings.evidenceJa: こっちは床に飛び散らせるほど汗だくだっていうのに、セイバーは汗一つかいていない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou is sweaty enough to scatter drops across the floor, while Saber has not shed a single drop of sweat.
findings.explanation: Saber's lack of sweat becomes lack of hard breathing.

findings.highlight: You really didn't hold back, Saber. It actually felt extraordinary having you just come at me without even having a chance of defending myself."
findings.evidenceJa: ……ほんと、容赦なくやってくれたなセイバー。こうまで一方的だと逆に清々しい」
findings.governingReading: Shirou claims such total one-sidedness is almost refreshing, then admits it is pure sour grapes.
findings.explanation: One-sided defeat feeling perversely refreshing becomes extraordinary.

findings.highlight: "Yeah. Thanks to this training, I think I can calmly deal with a Doberman running at me with its leash off.
findings.evidenceJa: 「そうだな。おかげで、今なら首輪が外れたドーベルマンが走ってきても冷静に対処できる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou imagines coping with an uncontrolled Doberman that has slipped its collar.
findings.explanation: A Doberman whose collar came off becomes one merely off its leash.

findings.highlight: I've always thought I trained myself more than the average person, but now I'm ashamed for throwing in the towel after just two hours of sparring with Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: 体だけは人並み以上に鍛えてきたつもりだったが、二時間セイバーと打ち合っただけでギブアップとは情けない。
findings.governingReading: Shirou had believed that at least his body was trained beyond an average person's.
findings.explanation: Training the body above the ordinary level becomes training generally.

findings.highlight: "That is not true. Your attacks were all quite powerful. I was so enthused by your efforts that I forgot to strike back at times."
findings.evidenceJa: 「いいえ、そのような事はありません。シロウの打ち込みは一心で、力がありました。時に、あまりの熱心さに対応を忘れたほどです」
findings.governingReading: Saber praises Shirou's single-minded, forceful attacks and says their intensity sometimes made her forget her response.
findings.explanation: Saber forgetting how to respond to Shirou's zeal becomes enthusiasm that makes her forget to strike back.

findings.governingReading: After Saber leaves to fetch water, Shirou says he was saved or relieved, then wonders what exactly he was saved from.
findings.explanation: Feeling rescued from embarrassment becomes narrowly escaping danger.

findings.highlight: It's still strange to think that she is Saber, a Servant, and someone dedicated to fighting.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな彼女がセイバーのサーヴァントであり、戦いを肯とする事には、やはり違和感がある。
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels dissonance that this beautiful person is the Saber Servant and affirms or accepts fighting.
findings.explanation: Saber affirming battle becomes being dedicated to it.
